title: Relation extraction (gene-drug, fusion-phenotype), grounded
context: Once entity extraction is stable, grounded relation extraction (gene-drug, fusion-phenotype) adds structure for consumers. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Every relation is source-spanned and aggregate-only; a domain reviewer verifies a sample.
objective: Build grounded relation extraction (gene-drug, fusion-phenotype) with mandatory source spans.
acceptanceCriteria: Relation extraction (gene-drug, fusion-phenotype) produces only grounded relations, each with a verbatim source span and aggregateOnly:true.
Groundedness re-location check enforced in CI; ungrounded relations dropped.
Domain reviewer verifies a sample for scientific faithfulness; no patient-level data or advice.
Code MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; DCO signed-off.
